prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CityX game 3D modeling reference, four-panel comparison board.
Architectural identity: modest modern public community center, muted sage hipped standing seam roof, warm cream plaster, red brick side wing, glass entry under flat canopy. Not a grand city hall or school. Design a survivor shelter repurposed from that modest modern community center on a 60m by 80m rectangular site. Same exact building, same camera, same plot layout in all FOUR panels, no redesign between states.
Composition: large 2 by 2 board, clear small English labels: upper left "ISOLATED / DAY", upper right "CONNECTED / DAY", lower left "ISOLATED / NIGHT", lower right "CONNECTED / NIGHT". Architectural game asset renders at 45 degree elevated three quarter camera, entire plot visible including roof, generous details, premium stylized realistic low-poly art, physically convincing geometry, bevels, weathered plaster, red brick side wing, muted sage standing seam roof. Main hall around 35 by 25 meters, one to two stories, front glass entrance under a flat canopy, skylights, roof radio antenna and small solar array, adjoining lower wing. Front court, side basketball half-court with retained markings, three small practical canvas tents, supply crates, water tanks, a backup generator at rear side, localized improvised timber boards over some windows, partial low barricades at entrance, trees, ordinary benches. No military base or immense wall, no giant rubble or collapsed roof, people have survived here. Main hall remains habitable.
Left isolated pair: maintained small inhabited refuge in otherwise neglected site. Slight surface wear, a few weeds, clustered supplies and temporary shelters; two to three windows softly lit and a modest entrance emergency lamp at NIGHT, one tiny lit tent, a very small warm pool around entrance. This must remain clearly visibly inhabited at night, with warm lights visible from above through two skylights, but most facade and outer street lamps remain unlit. Cool blue ambient moonlight allows all geometry to be read; do not make left panel black.
Right connected pair: same structure, tents, positions and camera; cleaned approach, organized supplies and patched windows, no wholesale rebuilding. At NIGHT more but NOT all windows warm, brighter skylights and entrance, several working warm streetlights create a connected chain of light along the front road and safe courtyard. No searchlights, no floodlight glare, no neon. The difference is sparse isolated islands of light versus stable connected everyday civilization, not only brighter global exposure.
Shared background neutral gray blue studio diorama, same ground extents and layout, no surrounding city or fog, no dramatic fire, no zombies, no HUD, no weapons. High quality texture/material study that can be built faithfully in Blender.
